rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a once-living person, animal, or plant has died.

example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 cam4 jat6 sei2 zo2

rows.note: Use this for something dull or lacking vitality; of a place, it means visibly lacking activity rather than strictly having no residents.

example.english: This street feels lifeless at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 je6 maan5 hou2 mou5 sang1 hei3

rows.note: Use this for something inanimate or unable to support life, rather than something that was alive and has died.

example.english: This plastic toy is lifeless and cannot move on its own.
example.traditional: 呢件膠公仔冇生命，唔會自己郁。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 gaau1 gung1 zai2 mou5 sang1 ming6 m4 wui5 zi6 gei2 juk1
